info.title: Ordoro Universal API
info.description: Ordoro is an inventory, order, shipping, purchasing, and manufacturing operations platform for ecommerce teams. This app wraps the official Ordoro API for products, orders, manufacturing orders, purchase orders, suppliers, warehouses, labels, returns, and company operations.
